v2 outputs committed (the run used code at efa3bd2)

v1_runs.regenerated: v1-regenerated-4bf5481 is a fresh deterministic re-run of code 4bf5481 under protocol v1 made during review. It is a reproduction, not the original bytes; the original hashes were never recorded, so byte-identity to the original run cannot be shown.

v1_runs.status: two runs happened under protocol v1 (after 895487f and after 4bf5481). Their output bytes were overwritten before ever being committed and are IRRECOVERABLE.

known_defects: sensitivity enumerated plans once at nominal prices, omitting plans newly affordable at lower prices
misclassification used a centered perturbation (no-measurement 0.50 is an artifact of m0=0), not the finalist's actual margin
control_off_grid_refused was hard-coded True and not executed in that run (its unit test passed separately)
baseline-not-beaten count (315) did not separate baseline-ineligible scenarios
repeat reads of R1/R3/R4 were silently treated as independent
virtual-readout calibration 'none needed' could read as a calibrated instrument model
